question: With source-exact depth and boundary fixed, which frozen learned positive factor changes body-swept task states: support, obstacle, or their interaction?

learned_support_only.interpretation: Learned support preserves every reference-known state but improperly promotes reference-UNKNOWN cells to definite states. Support probability cannot be allowed to create support validity; it may only veto an independently established geometric support state.

learned_obstacle_only.interpretation: Learned obstacle evidence is fail-closed in this substitution but loses 23 of 33 reference-known cells and emits no OCCUPIED state. Positive obstacle evidence is the coverage bottleneck.

learned_support_plus_obstacle.interpretation: The combined arm is identical to obstacle-only; obstacle undercoverage dominates the current positive-factor composition.

decision.next_successor_scope: Freeze the current obstacle logit and use consumed ARKit/TUM source-valid labels in parent-disjoint leave-one-parent-out calibration of POSITIVE, VERIFIED_NEGATIVE and UNKNOWN. Require per-parent false-negative control plus nonzero positive and verified-negative coverage before any reducer task seam. Support remains veto-only.

claim_boundary: Prediction-first factor substitution anatomy on one already-consumed synthetic-exact Development parent. It identifies support-validity fail-open behavior and obstacle-positive undercoverage; it does not establish task superiority, independent cross-sensor generalization, deployment, product readiness, default-App eligibility, navigation utility or assistive safety.
